canonical_project: CtrlS Guwahati Data Centre (Tech City Park, Bongora)
notes: Assam IT Minister Keshab Mahanta laid the foundation stone of the Rated-4 data centre at Tech City Park, Bongora, Guwahati (Kamrup district); initial ~1,000 racks, expandable to 2,000+ racks. InfotechLead (2022) reports the foundation ceremony; Baxtel lists construction as initiated. No recent completion/operational news found - current status uncertain; grade B.
